lines.quote: RF characterisation of photodetector front ends using Rohde & Schwarz ZVA-series network analysers and FSW spectrum analysers; performed gain-flatness verification across the 100 MHz – 6 GHz band during integration of three product-line receiver modules, including impedance matching and cable-loss calibration

That part of the work – hands-on measurements on a bench, chasing cable losses and impedance mismatches, comparing measured results against what the simulation promised – has become what I most enjoy doing day to day.
